name: Sarnafil® Décor Profile PVC
summary: Sarnafil® Décor Profile PVC is an polyvinyl chloride (PVC) extruded profile made which is welded to PVC sheet waterproofing membranes to replicate standing seam metal roofing systems.
metaDescription: Sarnafil® Décor Profile PVC is an polyvinyl chloride (PVC) extruded profile made which is welded to PVC sheet waterproofing membranes to replicate standing seam metal roofing systems.
usage: Sarnafil® Décor Profile PVC creates an appearance of a standing seam metal roof
packaging: Cardboard containers of 25 pieces including connector plugs.

items.label: Storage conditions
items.text: The product must be stored in original, unopened and undamaged sealed packaging in dry conditions at temperatures between +5 °C and +30 °C. Always refer to packaging.

items.label: System structure
items.text:
The following products must be considered for use depending on roof design:
Sarnamatic® 681/661 Conversion kit Decor Profile
Sarnafil® G 410 EL-types
Sarnafil® G 410 EL Felt-types
Sarnafil® S 327 EL-types

items.label: Reaction to fire
items.text: Class E | (EN ISO 11925-2, classification to EN 13501-1)

items.label: APPLICATION
items.text:
Installation procedure
Ensure the Sarnafil® Décor Profile PVC is tacked into position at the desired centres and hot air weld into place to the roof membrane. Join two or more Sarnafil® Décor Profile PVCs together, using the connector plugs supplied. Finish the end of the profile with a piece of hot air welded membrane if required.
